## Data Profile SQL

```sql
WITH monthly_rev AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."orders.order_date" AS "order_date",
    _stage_inner."orders.rev" AS "rev"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS "orders.order_date",
      CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.rev"
    FROM orders AS orders
    GROUP BY
      DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)
  ) AS _stage_inner
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "monthly_rev._count",
  COUNT(DISTINCT monthly_rev.order_date) AS "monthly_rev.order_date_count_distinct",
  CAST(AVG(monthly_rev.rev) AS DOUBLE) AS "monthly_rev.rev_avg"
FROM monthly_rev AS monthly_rev
LIMIT 0
```

args.message: This can't be done with monthly_rev. That model already adds revenue up to one row per month (DATE_TRUNC to month of orders.order_date), so it has no daily detail. A query asking it for daily figures fails with an error saying a month-level column can't be split into days. The only January 2025 figure it has is one monthly total. To get daily revenue, the source orders model would need to be used instead (sum of amount grouped by day of order_date).
